Incorporates hill workouts to build climbing strength and power, essential for trail running.

reasoning: Plan A is the better choice for a trail runner aiming to become faster. While both plans prioritize easy running, Plan A incorporates key elements crucial for speed development that Plan B lacks: tempo runs and hill workouts. These sessions specifically target threshold pace and climbing strength, both vital for trail running performance. Plan B's focus solely on easy running, while good for building a base, won't provide the necessary stimulus to improve speed and power on varied terrain.
